When client-side rendering is enabled in the Studio, allow the experimental Chromium HTML-in-canvas API to be used for capturing frames. See [HTML-in-canvas docs](/docs/client-side-rendering/html-in-canvas).

## CLI flag

Use `--allow-html-in-canvas` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                               | Flag                     |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio) | `--allow-html-in-canvas` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#allowhtmlincanvas)
- [`renderStillOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-still-on-web#allowhtmlincanvas)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setAllowHtmlInCanvasEnabled(true);
```
